{{short description|American mathematician}}
'''George Gasper''' is a mathematician at [[Northwestern University]] working on [[special function]]s, especially [[orthogonal polynomials]] and [[basic hypergeometric series]],  who introduced the [[Askey–Gasper inequality]].
